import random,time
from syntax import parse_policy
from ebpf.create_dfa import create,PolicyError
random.seed(500)
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)];reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
for L,N in [(6,3000),(6,5000),(7,5000),(8,4000),(8,6000),(10,4000),(12,3000)]:
 S=set()
 while len(S)<N:
  S.add(tuple(random.randrange(16) for _ in range(L)))
 text='(startswith(A,B) and contains(C,D)) allow;(endswith(D,A) or not(match(E))) allow;(contains(C,D) and startswith(A,B)) drop;(not(endswith(D,A)) and contains(C,D)) allow;'
 text+=''.join('match('+','.join(names[i] for i in t)+') allow;' for t in S)
 p=parse_policy(text)
 t=time.time()
 try:
  im=create(text,reg,p);res=('ok',len(im['rows']))
 except Exception as e:res=(type(e).__name__,str(e))
 print(L,N,'path',N*L+16,'atoms',N+8,'time',round(time.time()-t,3),res)
